newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V AJAX AMSTERDAM TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V AJAX AMSTERDAM TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final second leg match between Spain's Atletico Madrid and Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands:

Atletico Madrid: 1-Jose Molina; 15-Carlos Aguilera, 6-Santi Denia, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 20-Delfi Geli, 24-Radek Bejbl, 21-Jose Caminero, 14-Diego Simeone, 10-Milinko Pantic, 9-Juan Eduardo Esnaider, 19-Kiko Narvaez.

Ajax: 1-Edwin van der Sar; 29-Mario Melchiot, 3-Danny Blind, 4-Frank de Boer, 8-Richard Witschge, 19-Arnold Scholten, 18-Kiki Musampa, 10-Jari Litmanen, 7-Tijani Babangida, 6-Ronald de Boer, 11-Marc Ovarmars,
